title: Nano-enabled fertilization alters nitrogen release dynamics and improves fertilizer use efficiency by reducing volatilization and leaching losses: Insights from 15N tracing and kinetic modelling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00403B, Paper
Surya Teja Varanasi, Kannan Pandian, Meena Sadasivam, Raju Marimuthu, Prabu Padanillay Chidambaram, Raja Kalimuthu, Mohamed Roshan Abu Firnass Mustaffa
Inefficient nitrogen (N) management in agroecosystems is largely driven by rapid nutrient release and substantial losses from conventional urea fertilizers, resulting in low nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) and environmental concerns....
